svg.data-spec:
title: funcd workflows kind: flow
wf: Workflow | steps, stores @amber
[Starts a run] gray right cli: funcdctl | workflow run, apply sensor: Sensor | workflow action @amber [/]
run: WorkflowRun | input, pinned revisions @amber engine: Workflow engine | drives the steps @amber
[Steps] blue right fnstep: Function step | dispatched builtin: Built-in step | wait or pass child: Workflow step | a child run [/]
state: Run state | progress @db @coral
wf > run: each execution cli > run sensor > run run > engine engine > fnstep, builtin, child engine > state
